headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Office of Management and Budget if its director cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which Office of Management and Budget (OMB) officials would act as director, and in what order, if the director dies, resigns, or is otherwise unable to do the job. OMB is the White House office that prepares the federal budget and oversees how agencies spend money. No summary was provided, so details such as the specific positions named are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Office of Management and Budget
who_it_affects.how: It sets which of them would temporarily take over the director's duties if the position becomes empty or the director cannot act.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 3, 2025; the exact effective date is not stated in the available information.
